bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to commerce; prohibiting the sale of flavored nitrous oxide; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 325F.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[325F.079] SALE OF FLAVORED NITROUS OXIDE.

Subdivision 1.

Definitions.

(a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.

(b) "Flavored nitrous oxide" means a canister containing nitrous oxide that (1) imparts a taste or smell, and (2) is sold by a retailer.

(c) "Retailer" means a person, whether located within Minnesota or otherwise, engaged in the business of selling or offering for sale flavored nitrous oxide to a consumer in Minnesota.

Subd. 2.

Prohibition.

A retailer is prohibited from selling or offering for sale flavored nitrous oxide to a consumer in Minnesota.

Subd. 3.

Violation.

A person who violates this section is guilty of a misdemeanor.
additions: (a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.
(b) "Flavored nitrous oxide" means a canister containing nitrous oxide that (1) imparts a taste or smell, and (2) is sold by a retailer.
(c) "Retailer" means a person, whether located within Minnesota or otherwise, engaged in the business of selling or offering for sale flavored nitrous oxide to a consumer in Minnesota.
A retailer is prohibited from selling or offering for sale flavored nitrous oxide to a consumer in Minnesota.
A person who violates this section is guilty of a misdemeanor.
